extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians, researchers, librarians, and general readers seeking information about mathematical abstracting/review services
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic summary of the zbMATH Open abstracting and reviewing service: its producers, history, scope, formats covered, language and access information, and how reviews are produced and organised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access / Cost
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As of January 2021, the complete database is accessible for free. Previously only the first three records in a search were available without a subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coverage — Disciplines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The service provides reviews and abstracts for mathematics and related areas; areas closely related to mathematics are treated seriously alongside 'pure mathematics'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record depth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The database contains bibliographical data together with peer reviews and abstracts (record depth explicitly listed as 'Index, Abstracts, Reviews').

rubrics_metrics.name: Format coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The abstracting service reviews current articles, conference papers, books and other publications in mathematics, its applications, and related areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temporal coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The database includes older issues incorporated back to 1826 and incorporates the Jahrbuch entries from 1868–1942; history notes inclusion of material back to 1826 and earlier entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Update frequency
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The online service is updated daily (the printed issue frequency historically varied).

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages of reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews are predominantly in English, with occasional entries in German and French.

rubrics_metrics.name: Producer / Editorial responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Produced by European Mathematical Society, FIZ Karlsruhe, and the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: zbMATH Open is produced by the Berlin office of FIZ Karlsruhe with editors from the European Mathematical Society, FIZ Karlsruhe, and the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences; distribution previously via Springer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reviewer selection / review process
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer reviews done by mathematicians worldwide; reviewers are volunteers invited by the editors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers are invited based on their published work or a recommendation by an existing reviewer; reviews are contributed voluntarily by mathematicians internationally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification / Organisation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviews and records are organised by topic using the MSC codes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scale / size
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of records: more than 4 million
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The database contains over four million records and historically incorporated large backfiles such as the 200,000 entries of the Jahrbuch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of journals/serials reviewed
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviews more than 2,300 journals and serials worldwide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The service reviews a large set of serials globally, in addition to books and conference proceedings.
